original_test_intent: Verify all expected TEMP_HIB_1 through N sensors are correctly mapped to physical HIB assemblies and sensing locations and report human-readable temperature, status and thresholds matching the approved HIB thermal specification.
original_method: Enumerate every expected HIB and immutable raw/UI temperature identity, define each physical sensing location, collect complete temperature/unit/status/threshold metadata with synchronized nearby board, fan/PWM and power context, and compare each raw and WebUI result to the owner specification.
manual_activity: The owner provides HIB topology, sensing locations and thermal limits; an operator verifies raw/UI readability and passive context, and the owner adjudicates anomalies.
required_inputs: Physical HIB and sensor-location to SDR/Redfish/UI mapping
Temperature unit/scale/warning/critical threshold, expected range and response specification
Read-only nearby board temperatures, fan/PWM and HIB power context
UI refresh/rounding/sensor-lag tolerance, protected access and evidence/redaction policy
safety_requirements: Keep the check read-only and passive; never heat/load HIBs or change fan, threshold or thermal/power policy
Use protected authentication and complete non-truncated enumeration
Bind each reading to a physical HIB and sensing location with synchronized context
Preserve logs and stop/escalate on overtemperature, HIB fault, alarm, impossible/stale value or mapping/cooling issue
Do not retry after changing airflow or workload
agent_execution_scope: Enumerate and verify the complete HIB temperature population and physical mappings
Collect complete raw values, units, status, thresholds, identities and timestamps with passive context
Assist with synchronized WebUI capture and approved unit/rounding normalization
Report missing, extra, stale, alarm, placement or raw/UI/context/spec mismatches for owner verdict
Perform no thermal stimulus or independent DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Supply authoritative HIB/sensor-location map and thermal limits
Review physical/context, raw/UI discrepancies and alarms

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: ipmitool may expose a record, but a literal TEMP_HIB_1~N name and head-limited fallback cannot prove every HIB, sensing location, complete thresholds, UI presentation or thermal context.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely enumerate the complete SDR/Redfish inventory, select all owner-mapped HIB temperature records, capture full metadata and synchronized passive board/fan/power context, then correlate WebUI rows to the thermal specification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: TEMP_HIB_1~N scope, WebUI path, reading/threshold/spec comparison and 1/0-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH PACKAGE-GATED HIB TEMPERATURE POPULATION VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a per-HIB matrix containing assembly and sensing location, raw temperature/unit/status/threshold, nearby board/fan/power context and UI display, with population and specification results.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds physical sensing location and passive thermal context while replacing insecure/truncated reads, log clearing and active stimulation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One temperature or screenshot cannot cover HIB1..N or prove physical placement. Every expected HIB channel and threshold must be reconciled independently.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Generic HIB temperature may be board, inlet, outlet or component-local. Expected value and lag depend on placement and airflow, so label-only comparisons are unsafe.

project_override_considerations: If an HIB exposes multiple generic temperature channels or omits one by configuration, the owner must define expected population and naming; ODTEMP, VR or adjacent rail sensors cannot fill missing coverage.
expected_evidence: Exact source row/variant/hash and SUT/BMC/firmware/HIB topology/thermal spec revision
Per-HIB assembly/sensor-location to raw/UI identity matrix
Synchronized WebUI screenshots and approved scaling/rounding/lag comparison
Per-HIB discrepancies, no-stimulus/no-write/no-log-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria coherently target HIB temperatures and thresholds. Exact physical placement and thermal context are project inputs rather than contradictory source requirements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: HIB topology, sensing-location mapping, thermal specification and complete raw/UI/context evidence gate execution while static review remains complete.

review_improvement: Requires complete per-HIB physical placement and passive context so a readable family-name sensor response is not counted as full coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: A generic HIB temperature is ambiguous without a physical sensing location. Board, inlet and component-local sensors have different expected gradients and lag even on the same HIB. Correct validation therefore needs a per-HIB identity/location map and synchronized airflow and power context. Other HIB thermal families may corroborate trends but retain separate sensor domains and thresholds.
